{{dablink|For the chapter in ''[[The Shadow Rising]]'' by the same name, see ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 37|Imre Stand]]''.}}
'''Imre Stand''' is a location in the [[Aiel Waste]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Imre Stand}} It is a small watering hole in the lands held by the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. Imre Stand is about a day's travel from [[Rhuidean]] and [[Chaendaer]] and twelve days travel to [[Cold Rocks Hold]].{{ref/book|4|36}}{{ref/book|4|48}}

==Activities==
After leaving Chaendaer, [[Rhuarc]] intends to stop at Imre Stand for the night.{{ref/book|4|36}} Upon arriving there, the group finds that there had been a slaughter. While camping at the Stand, the group of Aiel, along with [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Matrim Cauthon]], [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Moiraine Damodred]], and [[Lan Mandragoran]] are attacked by [[Trolloc]]s and [[Myrddraal]].{{ref/book|4|37}}
